capabilities.name: Kalshi Market Trading
capabilities.description: Live Kalshi prediction market trading using V2 REST API with RSA-PSS auth. Scans markets, scores signals via Claude Haiku, sizes positions with Kelly criterion, executes trades.
capabilities.notes: RSA-PSS signing migrated from PKCS1v15 on 2026-07-30. Trading hours guard active.

capabilities.name: Polymarket US Trading
capabilities.description: Live Polymarket US prediction market trading via Ed25519 auth on api.polymarket.us. MLB/MLS/sports-championship strategy with GPT-4o signal generation.
capabilities.notes: Ed25519 auth. Cross-arb with Kalshi in alert mode via cashclaw_arb.

capabilities.name: Bundle Arbitrage
capabilities.description: Kalshi-only bundle arbitrage detection and atomic 2-leg execution. Triggers at ≥3¢ profit per bundle. Max $5 per arb ($2.50 per leg).
capabilities.notes: Logs to arb_cycle.jsonl. Naked leg unwind protocol if leg B fails.

capabilities.name: Cross-Platform Arb Alerts
capabilities.description: Cross-platform arbitrage detection between Kalshi and Polymarket US. Alert-only mode — detects opportunities and sends Telegram alerts for human approval due to semantic false-positive risk.
capabilities.notes: Alert-only due to semantic false-positive risk on cross-platform market matching.

capabilities.name: Alusi Core Gateway
capabilities.description: Main OpenClaw AI gateway and agent orchestration core. Handles all agent requests, routing, session management, approval gating via sovereign_proxy, and inter-agent communication.
business_kpis: All agent sessions routed through gateway
capabilities.notes: Port 8788. All financial actions require explicit approval.

capabilities.name: Telegram Operations
capabilities.description: Telegram bot integration for approvals, alerts, weekly reports, and bidirectional agent communication. Handles trading alerts, BLCO reports, and executive summaries.
capabilities.notes: Dual service: approvals handler + adapter. Both required for full functionality.

capabilities.name: Discord Operations
capabilities.description: Discord channel adapter for agent communications, status updates, and community-facing interactions.
capabilities.notes: DISCORD secret in secrets/.env.

capabilities.name: n8n Automation Engine
capabilities.description: n8n workflow automation platform. Routes approved outputs from sovereign_proxy, handles webhook integrations, Airtable sync, and inter-service automation.
capabilities.notes: Currently 0 workflows registered. Critical gap: sovereign_proxy outputs need n8n wiring.

capabilities.name: Mission Control UI
capabilities.description: Central command and control web interface. Real-time operational dashboard for all Open Empire services. Target: unified view of all portfolios, agents, and P&L.

capabilities.notes: Source at ~/.openclaw/workspace/mission-control/. Integration plan in OPEN_EMPIRE_MISSION_CONTROL_INTEGRATION_PLAN_V1.md.

capabilities.name: PostgreSQL Data Layer
capabilities.description: PostgreSQL 18.3 data persistence for all trading, governance, signals, approvals, and audit data. Three databases: clawdb (primary), openclaw (agent ops), postgres (system).
business_kpis: Tables: agent_events, approvals, daily_pnl, health_log, signals, trades, vault_entries
capabilities.notes: PostgreSQL 18.3. LC_ALL fixed. All trade records and approvals persist here.

capabilities.name: Ollama Local Inference

capabilities.notes: Route batch work here. Real-time signal scoring → Haiku. Template-first for structured outputs.
